text_en: First of all, then, I urge that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for everyone,
text_cn: 首先我劝导众人，要为一切人恳求、祈祷、转求和谢恩，

text_en: for kings and all who are in high positions, so that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and dignity.
text_cn: 并为众君王和一切有权位的人，为叫我们能以全心的虔敬和端庄，度宁静平安的生活。

text_en: This is right and is acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
text_cn: 这原是美好的，并在我们的救主天主面前是蒙受悦纳的。

text_en: who desires everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
text_cn: 因为他愿意所有的人都得救，并得以认识真理，

text_en: For there is one God; there is also one mediator between God and humankind, Christ Jesus, himself human,
text_cn: 因为天主只有一个，在天主与人之间的中保也只有一个，就是降生成人的基督耶稣，

text_en: who gave himself a ransom for all —this was attested at the right time.
text_cn: 他奉献了自己，为众人作赎价：这事在所规定的时期已被证实，

text_en: For this I was appointed a herald and an apostle (I am telling the truth, I am not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
text_cn: 而我也是为了这事，被立为宣道者和宗徒──我说的是实话，并非说谎──在信仰和真理上，做了外邦人的教师。

text_en: I desire, then, that in every place the men should pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or argument;
text_cn: 我愿意男人们在各地举起圣洁的手祈祷，不应发怒和争吵；

text_en: also that the women should dress themselves modestly and decently in suitable clothing, not with their hair braided, or with gold, pearls, or expensive clothes,
text_cn: 又愿意女人们服装端正，以廉耻和庄重装饰自己，不要用鬈发和金饰，或珍珠和极奢华的服装，

text_en: but with good works, as is proper for women who profess reverence for God.
text_cn: 而要以善行装饰自己，这才合乎称为虔敬天主的女人。

text_en: Let a woman learn in silence with full submission.
text_cn: 女人要在沉静中受教，事事服从。

text_en: I permit no woman to teach or to have authority over a man; she is to keep silent.
text_cn: 我不准许女人施教，也不准许她管辖男人，但要她安于沉静，

text_en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve;
text_cn: 因为亚当是先受造的，以后才是厄娃。

text_en: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a transgressor.
text_cn: 亚当没有受骗，受骗陷于背命之罪的是女人。

text_en: Yet she will be saved through childbearing, provided they continue in faith and love and holiness, with modesty.
text_cn: 但她若持守信德、爱德、圣德和庄重，藉着生育，必能获救。
